meta.initial_start_probability: clip(0.16 + 0.08 × experienced + 0.10 × saved − 0.025 × crochet + 0.04 × latent intent, 0.02, 0.65)
meta.initial_start_delay_days: Uniform from 0.5 to 20; some starts occur after the activation window
meta.return_probability: clip(0.43 × exp(−0.16 × week) + 0.13 × intended early starter + 0.05 × experienced + 0.04 × latent intent, 0.02, 0.85)
meta.limitations: Illustrative assumptions, not calibrated to Ravelry. Telemetry is complete by construction. Retention associations reflect simulated selection and intent, not causality.

assumed_effect.interpretation: Simulation only; no evidence of Ravelry feature effectiveness.

planning.method: Two-sided normal approximation, Cohen h; no attrition/inference across repeated looks

sql.fct_product_events.sql:
-- Grain: one unique business event; transport retries retain the same event_id.
select event_id, user_id, event_name, occurred_at, received_at,
       session_id, pattern_id, schema_version
from {{ source('demo', 'synthetic_events') }}
qualify row_number() over (partition by event_id order by received_at) = 1
sql.dim_discovery_users.sql:
-- Grain: account entering discovery. No real users or Ravelry behavioural data.
with first_discovery as (
    select user_id, min(occurred_at) as first_discovery_at
    from {{ ref('fct_product_events') }}
    where event_name = 'discovery_viewed' group by user_id
), first_open as (
    select e.user_id, min(e.occurred_at) as first_open_at
    from {{ ref('fct_product_events') }} e join first_discovery d using (user_id)
    where e.event_name = 'pattern_opened' and e.occurred_at >= d.first_discovery_at
    group by e.user_id
), outcomes as (
    select d.user_id,
        min(e.occurred_at) filter (where e.event_name = 'project_started'
            and e.occurred_at >= o.first_open_at) as first_start_at,
        min(e.occurred_at) filter (where e.event_name = 'pattern_saved'
            and e.occurred_at >= o.first_open_at) as first_save_at
    from first_discovery d left join first_open o using (user_id)
    left join {{ ref('fct_product_events') }} e on e.user_id = d.user_id
        and e.occurred_at >= d.first_discovery_at
    group by d.user_id
)
select u.*, d.first_discovery_at,
    date_trunc('week', d.first_discovery_at)::date as cohort_week,
    o.first_open_at, x.first_save_at, x.first_start_at,
    d.first_discovery_at + interval '14 days' <= timestamptz '2026-10-26 00:00:00+00' as mature_14d,
    coalesce(o.first_open_at < d.first_discovery_at + interval '14 days', false) as opened_14d,
    coalesce(x.first_save_at < d.first_discovery_at + interval '14 days', false) as saved_14d,
    coalesce(x.first_start_at < d.first_discovery_at + interval '14 days', false) as started_14d,
    case when x.first_start_at is not null then
        epoch(x.first_start_at - d.first_discovery_at) / 86400.0 end as days_to_start
from {{ source('demo', 'synthetic_users') }} u
join first_discovery d using (user_id)
left join first_open o using (user_id)
left join outcomes x using (user_id)
sql.fct_discovery_weeks.sql:
-- Grain: discovery account × calendar week with at least one qualifying event.
select distinct d.user_id, date_trunc('week', e.occurred_at)::date as activity_week,
    date_diff('week', d.cohort_week, date_trunc('week', e.occurred_at)::date) as weeks_since_discovery
from {{ ref('fct_product_events') }} e
join {{ ref('dim_discovery_users') }} d using (user_id)
where e.event_name in ('discovery_viewed', 'pattern_opened', 'pattern_saved', 'project_started')
  and e.occurred_at >= d.first_discovery_at
